column1: # THE POINT OF THIS TABLE, AND IT IS THE WHOLE POINT:
# The two rows are the SAME author, the SAME technique, and OPPOSITE grant status.
# Row 1 is ungranted. Row 2 is a clean, complete, unmodified MIT payload at 1060 B.
# Row 2 passes every licence instrument this base owns, including p305's own new clause test.
# BOTH are undeployable in the EU, for a reason no licence check can see.
# => A CLEAN MIT GRANT DOES NOT MAKE A PROHIBITED PRACTICE DEPLOYABLE.
# DAiSEE itself: multi-label video dataset of students watching MOOCs, labelled for
# engagement + frustration + confusion + boredom. Affect recognition from faces, by construction.
# The compliant substitution (see P84): infer mastery from RESPONSE data — correctness, latency,
# spacing — never from the face. fsrs4anki (MIT, 1079 B) and the pyKT family already carried
# by this base do exactly that, and are untouched by Art 5(1)(f).
